core.name: Five-Star Service Hotline
core.text:
Enters battle with 60 Positive Reviews. Each 1% of initial CRIT Rate above 50% gives +{0} Impact (max +100).
Malicious Complaint (from Paper!): if the enemy is then Stunned, the Stun lasts 2s longer and its DMG Multiplier rises by {1}% (once per Stun).
Positive Reviews (max 120): +0.6 per second in combat, +7.5 when a Rock, Scissors or Paper! heavy hit lands (once per use).
With 90+, when she opens a Chain window with Welcome Mat, Get Lost! or Forward Call, the next Agent's Chain becomes an Ultimate (costs 60). If Get Lost! hits without a Chain window, she spends 90 to force one, again turning the next Chain into an Ultimate.
Reaching 90 Reviews or using an Ultimate gives 1 Customer Complaint (max 1).

ability.name: External Line
ability.text: Her EX Special CRIT DMG +50%. EX Special or Ultimate gives the squad Overwhelmingly Positive: +40% DMG for 15s (her EX or Ultimate extends it by 10s while under 35s). Rock, Scissors and Paper! heavy hits add DMG from the previous Agent: 320% of an Attack Agent's ATK, or 400% of a Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

mindscapes: Positive Reviews from time and from EX hits +16%. During Overwhelmingly Positive, the squad ignores 15% All-Attribute RES.
Malicious Complaint adds +20% more Stun DMG Multiplier, and enemies with it take +15% DMG from everyone.
Enters combat with 20 Energy (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). +500 ATK during Overwhelmingly Positive.

An ally who enters with an Ultimate through her Core Passive gets Aftertone: their hits make Dialyn deal 480% of her ATK as Physical DMG (counts as EX Special; once per 1s, up to 12 times). One ally at a time.
